title: Maximum Number of Non-Overlapping Substrings
summary: Given a string s consisting of lowercase letters, find the maximum number of non-overlapping substrings such that each substring includes all occurrences of any character it contains.
statement: Given a string s consisting of lowercase letters, find the maximum number of non-overlapping substrings such that each substring includes all occurrences of any character it contains. The solution with the minimum total length of substrings is guaranteed to be unique.
constraints: Every returned substring must contain every occurrence in s of each character it contains.
Maximize the number of non-overlapping substrings, then minimize their total length.
hints: Record the first and last occurrence of every character.
Only a first occurrence can start a minimal closed interval; expand its end for every character encountered.
Reject an interval if an encountered character begins before it.
Earliest-finish interval scheduling maximizes the count, while minimal closed candidates give the unique minimum total length.
editorial: Earliest-finish interval scheduling maximizes the count, while minimal closed candidates give the unique minimum total length.

tests.explanation: The minimal valid choices e, f, and ccc are disjoint and give the maximum count three.
The minimal maximum-count answer is bb, cc, and d; choosing abba would be longer.
